must_contain: In M2 the token an HIP generates is the link token, asked for one patient at a time with abhaAddress, name, gender and yearOfBirth, adding abhaNumber when the patient has one.
Generating a link token needs a gateway session token first, and the call carries your HIP id in the X-HIP-ID header.
notes: A real question from the live Ask AI panel that failed there, kept in the reader's exact words. Two words with no module: a reader on M2 means the link token, and the answer should also make plain that the gateway session token comes first, since that is the other token a first-day developer confuses it with. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/endpoints/m2-generate-link-token.md, 'Ask for a link token for one patient'; 'Send `abhaAddress`, `name`, `gender` and `yearOfBirth` as you hold them for the patient. Add `abhaNumber` when the patient has one linked to the address.'; Before you start, 'A gateway session token and your HIP id. Send the `REQUEST-ID`, `TIMESTAMP`, `X-CM-ID` and `X-HIP-ID` headers.'
